question:
A customer undergoes an IT security review assessment. The auditor must have read-only access to the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch to perform the configuration review. The customer implements this security role for the auditor: role name audit rule 1 permit command * rule 2 - Output omitted - username auditor password C4SAFF1B05EB1968Sc0 role audit
Which configuration snippet must complete the configuration?
theory: Cisco NX-OS RBAC lets a permit rule override a deny rule when they come from different roles a user holds, but WITHIN a single role, a broad rule like 'permit command *' would allow the auditor to enter configuration mode unless a more specific deny is added for that exact command. Adding 'deny command configure terminal' explicitly blocks the auditor from ever entering config mode, hardening the role into a true read-only auditor role even though the base rule is permissive. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - Role-Based Access Control, Rules)
